_method: properties.neighbors is derived from these simplified polygons: two communities are listed as neighbours when any boundary vertex of one lies within 250 m of a boundary segment of the other. It is a proximity test on generalised geometry, not a topological adjacency computation, so it can miss a narrow touch or include a near miss. Recomputed after the four ZCTA shapes replaced their CSA fragments, so it now reflects the wider community outlines.
